_: Nipple-areola skin: glabrous (or nearly), pigmented, keratinised skin over a dermis full of smooth muscle (an areolar muscle ~2 mm thick at the nipple base tapering to the limbus; circular and radial fibres), with no fat directly beneath; Montgomery tubercles (sebaceous). Two responses: smooth-muscle contraction (cold, touch: areola shrinks and wrinkles, nipple rises) and a vascular response (vasocongestion: nipple lengthens and widens, areola swells). Values for an adult woman, not lactating. SKIN lane 11-07.
